title: Littlewood Conjecture
exact_target: For every two real numbers, can arbitrarily large common integer multiples make the product of their distances to integers, times that multiplier, arbitrarily small?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1512 (NUM-018). CC BY 4.0.

Steven Robertson, \emph{Combinatorics on Number Walls and the $P(t)$-adic Littlewood Conjecture}, arXiv:2307.00955v3 (2025), opening of Section 1, the classical real Littlewood conjecture before the function-field variants.
